note: v6 script (45 s), for the pitch to the hospital's CEO: confident, a little wit. One line per beat; start_ms is where it begins, max_ms the room it has. voice defaults to am_puck (narrator); em_alex (native Spanish) plays the interpreter in the hook. v7: Chatterbox reads it (voice_chatterbox.py); a line's cb.seed picks its take, chosen so the take fits max_ms and Whisper hears every word (README). H.U.M.C. is dotted so it is read as letters.
